description: Use this only for explicit site-level consultations: the user asks about a site's identity, location, current overview, energy summary, status, component health, or explicitly requests its dashboard. If a named site must be resolved, call list_sites first and pass its siteId. Do not call this just because a request mentions a site, asks for the account's site list, lists a site's devices, or asks for a device's details/status/history. For those requests, return the corresponding list or device panel. If the user explicitly asks for both site-level information and device details, return both panels. Do not use this panel for requests explicitly asking for raw JSON or site energy history. Falls back to a concise text summary when the MCP host cannot render Apps.
name: get_site_dashboard
title: 站点仪表盘
